common.title: Biological Incident
common.line: A real biological incident with model involvement: a deliberate release or a laboratory escape involving a designed or modified agent.

common.title: Open Weights Capability Jump
common.line: An open-weight release lands within a few months of the closed frontier.

common.title: Science Delivers
common.line: A significant research result, with AI doing what used to be the hard part.

notable.title: Frontier Access Denied
notable.line: The Union is cut off from the leading model at short notice, wholly or by nationality of user.

notable.title: Compute blackmarket bust
notable.line: A coordinated seizure of illicit GPU clusters rented with stolen identities for distributed training on the leaked open-weight frontier model is reported by two member states' police, exposing a rental black market.
